reports.title: Security Review Report for Polygon zkEVM
reports.description: Hexens security review (Dec 2022 to Feb 2023) of Polygon zkEVM covering the L1/L2 bridge and PoE smart contracts, the zkASM main ROM, the storage ROM and the PIL constraints of the prover. Four Critical and one High issue were found (ERC777 re-entrancy in the bridge, missing PIL constraints, zkASM context and memory bugs), all reported as fixed at the listed remediation commits.

versions.coverage: Solidity contracts of zkevm-contracts (bridge, PolygonZkEVM, global exit root, deposit tree). Remediation of 1 (Critical, ERC777 re-entrancy in PolygonZkEVMBridge.sol) and of informational items 10-12. The report scopes the whole repository without an audited commit and lists only this commit as containing the fixes of all reported issues (validated by Hexens); the initially audited revision is unknown.

PIL constraint files of the prover (only the PIL part of zkevm-proverjs is referenced by the findings). Remediation of 2 (Critical, storage.pil missing binary constraint) and 4 (Critical, main.pil missing isNeg constraint). The report scopes the whole repository without an audited commit and lists only this commit as containing the fixes of all reported issues (validated by Hexens); the initially audited revision is unknown.

zkASM main ROM. Remediation of 3 (Critical, CTX assignation in process-tx.zkasm/identity.zkasm), 4 (Critical, utils.zkasm part), 5 (High, maxmem handling in main.zkasm/create-terminate-context.zkasm) and lower-severity items 6-9, 15, 16; the findings cite the develop branch. The report scopes the whole repository without an audited commit and lists only this commit as containing the fixes of all reported issues (validated by Hexens); the initially audited revision is unknown.

zkASM storage ROM; no finding is located here. The report scopes the whole repository without an audited commit and lists only this commit as containing the fixes of all reported issues (validated by Hexens); the initially audited revision is unknown.

reports.title: Polygon Pessimistic Proofs Security Assessment (Summary Report)
reports.description: Trail of Bits one engineer-week review of the pessimistic-proof Rust crate (sparse/append-only Merkle trees, transfer and balance validation, signature and data commitments) proven in SP1. Only the summary report is public; it reports one Medium, two Low and several informational issues.

versions.coverage: Full review of the pessimistic-proof crate. Only the summary report is public (no finding list); ToB reported no High/Critical issue. A high-severity double-import bug found independently by the Polygon team during the review is mentioned but is not a report finding.
